decision_scope: Separately predeclared v3 point1/batch64 read0/50/100 c1/c64, two full forward/reverse repetitions. Preserve all logical-call/item/outcome/attempt populations. Report per-read, per-write and merged whole-call histograms; never average percentiles or divide batch latency by keys. Accounting may be valid while healthy single-attempt/all-success suitability fails. No equal-durability or sustained-capacity claim.
durability: Three-voter volatile WAL with normal sync calls; standalone memory Redis, save and AOF off
final_dataset_scope: Full paginated dataset plus sentinel, exact deterministic bytes, configured nonce budget and deterministic write-key membership. Exact issued nonce set and concurrent write order cannot be inferred from aggregate reports; no full-history/linearizability claim.
storage_scope: 32GiB tmpfs/96GiB disk preflight for every arm,16GiB/64GiB runtime guard with statvfs alongside unchanged resources. Existing tmpfs32GiB preflight/8GiB endpoint and hash-retention predicates remain. An intervention leaves timing incomplete and all artifacts retained; no rerun. The configured10M cap is not a space bound below available capacity; smoke extrapolation is operational guidance only.
